question: According to the official GATE 2027 question paper pattern, how many questions and total marks does a GATE paper carry?
solution: The official GATE 2027 pattern page states: 10 General Aptitude + 55 subject = 65 questions, total 100 marks. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/question_paper_pattern
subject: Exam pattern
